# DopaBrain

> Evidence-based psychological self-assessments, cognitive training coaches, and emotional wellness tools available in 12 languages. Instant, private, client-side, with zero mandatory signup.

DopaBrain (https://dopabrain.com) is an interactive mental health, cognitive fitness, and self-discovery platform. It supports 12 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Russian, Hindi, Indonesian, and Turkish. All assessments operate entirely client-side, ensuring user privacy and confidentiality.

## Core Psychological & Cognitive Tools

- [Interactive Mental Wellness Lab (150-Tool Hub)](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/wellness-lab.html): Curated 12-language pillar hub organizing all 150 browser-private CBT, somatic unwinding, burnout differential, boundary script, ADHD focus, social battery, and sleep reset tools by emotional need.
- [Stress Check](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/): Perceived stress assessment grounded in Cohen's Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) measuring physical, emotional, and cognitive stress dimensions. Features 100% private client-side processing, instant 1080x1920 Instagram/SNS Story Card generator for visual diagnostic summaries, 7-day somatic recovery plans, and curated evidence-based recovery reading.
- [Stress Decompression Plan](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/plan.html): Personalized multi-tier recovery plans based on perceived stress severity.
- [Stress Boundary Script Builder](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/script.html): Assertive communication scripts and professional boundary-setting templates.
- [Stress Relief Library](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/library.html): Somatic decompression exercises, physiological sigh guides, and guided progressive muscle relaxation.
- [HSP Sensitivity Test](https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/): Highly Sensitive Person self-assessment based on Dr. Elaine Aron's Sensory Processing Sensitivity (SPS) DOES model (Depth of processing, Overstimulation, Emotional reactivity, Sensing the subtle). Features high-resolution 1080x1920 Sensory Profile Story Card generator, low-stimulation 5-minute sensory reset protocol, and curated sensitivity literature.
- [HSP Sensory Reset](https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/reset.html): Low-stimulation sensory regulation protocol designed for quick recovery from sensory overload.
- [Future Self Continuity](https://dopabrain.com/future-self/): Longitudinal self-continuity simulation and temporal discounting exercise based on Dr. Hal Hershfield's behavioral psychology framework. Features client-side 1080x1920 Archetype Story Card canvas export, temporal connection metrics, and goal visualization.
- [Dilemma Decision Matrix](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/decision-matrix.html): Interactive weighted decision matrix based on the Pugh Decision Matrix method (Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis) for resolving dilemmas, breaking analysis paralysis, and comparing competing choices across weighted dimensions.
- [Burnout vs Stress Differential Matrix](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/burnout-stress-differential.html): Dual-axis 2D quadrant assessment distinguishing acute autonomic tension (PSS-10) from systemic occupational exhaustion (MBI), with localized tactical decompression protocols.
- [Dopamine Detox & Reset Protocol](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/dopamine-detox-protocol.html): Neural reward system assessment calculating cheap vs. compound dopamine ratios and generating tailored 24-hour digital reset schedules with ADHD-friendly substitute menus.
- [5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding & Panic Reset](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/grounding-exercise.html): Somatic anxiety and panic attack de-escalation tool guiding users through 5 sensory checkpoints with an interactive physiological cyclic sigh breathwork coach.
- [Cognitive Load & Brain Fog Calculator](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/cognitive-load-calculator.html): Executive function and working memory overload assessment calculating mental RAM consumption across 4 cognitive domains (open loops, sensory friction, decision density, biological fatigue) with real-time browser load telemetry and tailored neuro-decompression protocols.
- [Daily 60-Second Mind Check-In](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/daily-mind-checkin.html): Rate energy, tension & fog to get a personalized tool prescription + local 7-day streak.
- [Overthinking & Rumination Breaker](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/overthinking-rumination-breaker.html): Sort worries via the CBT Worry Tree, park unsolvable loops & run a 90s cognitive shuffle.
- [CBT Cognitive Distortion Reframer](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/cognitive-distortion-reframer.html): Spot 10 thinking traps (catastrophizing, mind reading) and craft a balanced thought card.
- [Somatic Tension Body Map & PMR](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/somatic-tension-body-map.html): Tap tight body zones (jaw, shoulders, chest, gut) for targeted unwinding & 60s PMR pacing.
- [Window of Tolerance Nervous System Check](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/window-of-tolerance-check.html): Detect hyperarousal (fight/flight) vs. hypoarousal (freeze/numb) and get matched regulation.
- [Emotion Regulation Interactive Planner](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotion-regulation-planner.html): Build a structured if-then regulation protocol for high-intensity emotional moments.
- [Emotional Energy Leak Audit](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotional-energy-audit.html): Pinpoint hidden daily energy drains, map restorers & draft a local Stop-Doing boundary card.
- [Social Battery Calculator & Recharge Planner](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/social-battery-recharge-planner.html): Calculate remaining social battery %, quiet recovery minutes & a warm early-exit script.
- [Healthy Boundary Script Builder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/boundary-script-builder.html): Generate calm, guilt-free boundary scripts across work, family, friends & dating scenarios.
- [Gaslighting & Manipulation Reality-Check](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/gaslighting-reality-check.html): Check 8 recurring distortion patterns, anchor 1 objective fact locally & get Grey-Rock scripts.
- [Codependency & Interdependence Audit](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/codependency-reset-audit.html): Rate 6 rescuing & mood-scanning habits to build a Detach-With-Love plan & Own-Lane script.
- [Attachment Trigger Decoder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/attachment-trigger-decoder.html): Decode anxious protest vs. avoidant shutdown triggers and rehearse a secure response.
